sentences.en: Medicine containers should be kept out of reach of children.
sentences.zh: 药品容器应放在孩子够不到的地方。

sentences.en: Sami found a container of antifreeze in the kitchen garbage.
sentences.zh: 萨米在厨房垃圾里发现了一个装有防冻液的容器。

sentences.en: Yanni keeps his burned-out light bulbs in a sealable container.
sentences.zh: 耶尼把用过的灯泡存放在一个密封的容器里。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：contain（容纳）+er（表物） →容器
